description: Resolve ASIN, Amazon /dp URL, or keywords to a marketplace URL. Pass marketplace + locale (amazon.com + en for United States users; amazon.se + sv for Sweden). Both optional — omitted means en-US Accept-Language → amazon.com, else amazon.se.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en (US), sv (Sweden). Optional — derived from the storefront when omitted.

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront for the end user: amazon.com (or us) for United States users — curated amazon.com/dp links in USD, English; amazon.se (or se) for Sweden. Optional: when omitted, an en-US Accept-Language selects amazon.com, otherwise amazon.se.

name: resolve_product
title: Resolve buy link
